title: Locally of finite type morphisms are etale-locally finite over smooth maps with geometrically integral fibres

standard_prerequisites.use: The chapter's local structure lemma for finite type morphisms (lemma-local-structure-finite-type), existence of elementary etale neighbourhoods trivialising fibres with geometrically irreducible fibres, and standard properties of smooth maps (quasi-compact separated smooth over an affine base is of finite presentation); cited inputs with the diagram construction written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Reduce to S affine and pick the initial commutative diagram from the local structure lemma.
Find an elementary etale neighbourhood of (S, s) and an open of the base change whose fibres are geometrically irreducible.
Lift the points x' and y' uniquely over the etale neighbourhood and verify the six stated properties.
Upgrade pi to finite presentation when f is locally of finite presentation.

proof_roadmap.step: Affine reduction, then local structure gives smooth Y with transcendental residue field.
Etale-local trivialization makes fibres geometrically integral.
The composed diagram is the required solution.

difficulty_reason: The local-local structure theorem: for f : X -> S locally of finite type and x over s with n equal to the local fibre dimension dim_x(X_s), there is a diagram with an elementary etale neighbourhood g : (X', x') -> (X, x), a second elementary etale neighbourhood e : (S', s') -> (S, s), a smooth map h : Y' -> S' of relative dimension n with geometrically integral fibres, and a finite map pi : X' -> Y' sending x' to y' with pi^{-1}(y') = {x'} and kappa(y') purely transcendental over kappa(s'); for finite presentation f the map pi can be taken of finite presentation. The retained proof reduces to S affine, applies the chapter's local structure lemma to obtain a smooth Y -> S with purely transcendental residue extension at y, uses etale-locality on X, builds an elementary etale neighbourhood whose pullback open Y' has geometrically irreducible fibres identifying the fibre with a prescribed affine space piece, selects the canonical points (x', s') and (y, s') above the originals, and verifies the outer rectangle satisfies all six listed properties; the author marks some minor details omitted inside this fully written construction. Retained author proof at lines 13462-13520.

dedup.scope: Refined local-local structure theorem; the underlying local structure lemma is a different statement used as input.
